title: Exporting projects
key_points: Godot has a system for exporting projects to various platforms.
Exporting allows developers to distribute compiled binaries without sharing the full project source code.
The export process can be automated from the command line using flags like --export-release.
There are two pack file formats: PCK (uncompressed, recommended) and ZIP (compressed).
limitations: Not all platforms have templates installed yet.
Exporting requires familiarity with the SDKs of each platform for mobile distribution.
asserts: The source documents Godot's built-in system for exporting projects to various platforms, including PC and mobile.
